key_insight: You can learn and compute game-theoretic equilibria even when the learner only sees ordinal (ranking) feedback instead of numeric utilities; the paper introduces algorithms that achieve sublinear regret and enable equilibrium convergence under this weak feedback model.
problem_solved: How to perform online learning and compute equilibria in adversarial or arbitrary environments when numeric utility values are unavailable (e.g., only rankings or preference orderings are observable due to human feedback or privacy constraints).
method: Formalize a ranking/ordinal feedback model that replaces numeric rewards with only comparative (pairwise or list) rankings observed after actions.

Design and analyze online learning algorithms that operate on ranking signals, proving sublinear regret guarantees in the online setting and showing convergence to appropriate equilibrium concepts in games.

Construct reductions and protocol-level modifications to adapt regret-minimizing dynamics (used for equilibrium computation) to work with ranking-only feedback while preserving convergence properties.
impact: This enables preference-driven and privacy-aware online learning and multi-agent equilibrium computation in settings with human feedback or limited numeric observability, broadening applicability of regret-based methods to real-world interactive systems.
visual_elements: Feedback loop diagram: learner picks action, environment returns an ordered list/ranking (not a numeric score); arrows showing update using ordinal info.
Regret vs. time plot: sublinear regret curve comparing ranking-feedback algorithm to numeric-feedback baseline.
Game dynamics visualization: trajectories of joint play converging to an equilibrium under ranking-based updates.
Icon set: human/user silhouette (human-in-the-loop), lock (privacy), and ranked list (ordinal feedback) to highlight motivations.
paper_title: Online Learning and Equilibrium Computation with Ranking Feedback
paper_authors: Mingyang Liu, Yongshan Chen, Zhiyuan Fan, Gabriele Farina, Asuman Ozdaglar
